study type: Longitudinal trend analysis (retrospective repeated cross-sectional data)
outcome: Prevalence of HBV infection in pregnant women
cohort: The study included 36,958 women giving birth at Chiang Mai University Hospital, Thailand, from January 2003 to December 2022, who had available HBV test results.
finding: The overall prevalence of HBV infection in pregnant women significantly decreased from 6.11% in 2003 to 3.15% in 2022, with the most significant reduction observed in the adolescent group (from 8.26% to 0%).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from January 2003 to December 2022, analyzed annually for trends.
